sources.source: script Numeric version "1.0.0"; entity E { state i: Int = 1; state r: Rat = 1; state v: Vec2 = vec2(0, 0); on update { let a: Rat = i + r; let b = i + 2; let c = v * 2; r = b; move c; } }

script Values version "1.0.0"; record Damage { amount: Int; critical: Bool; } enum Kind { Fire; Ice; } entity E { state d: Damage = Damage(amount = 1, critical = false); state k: Kind = Kind::Fire; state o: Option<Int> = Some(1); state r: Result<Int, Text> = Ok(2); on start { let amount = d.amount; match k { Kind::Fire => { log "fire"; } Kind::Ice => { log "ice"; } } match o { Some(v) => { let x = v; } None => { log "none"; } } match r { Ok(v) => { let x = v; } Err(e) => { log e; } } } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; import math.lib; import world.api; entity E { state out: Rat = 0; on update { out = twice(2); let temp = world.temperature(vec2(0, 0)); call audio.play("tick"); } }
module math.lib version "1.0.0"; export fn twice(x: Rat) -> Rat = x * 2;
module world.api version "1.0.0"; export capability world.temperature(Vec2) -> Rat observation; export capability audio.play(Text) -> Unit effect;
script Root version "1.0.0"; import a; import b; entity E { on start { call world.ping(); } }
module a version "1.0.0"; export capability world.ping() -> Unit effect;
module b version "1.0.0"; export capability world.ping() -> Unit effect;
script Pure version "1.0.0"; fn add1(x: Int) -> Int = x + 1; fn add2(x: Int) -> Int = add1(add1(x)); entity E { state x: Int = 0; on start { x = add2(3); } }

script Scope version "1.0.0"; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { let base = 1; if true { let branch = 2; out = branch; } else { let other = 3; out = other; } for i in 0 .. 2 { let loopValue = i + base; out = loopValue; } } }
script Events version "1.0.0"; entity E { on pulse(value: Rat) { log "pulse"; } on start { emit pulse(1); emit pulse(2.5); } }
script Beh version "1.0.0"; behavior Move { state speed: Rat = 1; on update { let dir = input.move2d(); move dir * speed; animate "Walk"; } } entity E { use Move; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; x: Rat; } entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum K { A; A; } entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Unit = 1; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Option<Unit>; } entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; capability bad() -> Option<Unit> observation; entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record Node { next: Option<Node>; } entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record A { b: B; } record B { a: Option<A>; } entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int, x: Int) -> Int = x; entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int) -> Unit = x; entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 0; state x: Int = 1; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on pulse { return; } on pulse { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 0; on pulse(x: Int) { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on pulse(x: Int) { let x = 1; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = 1; if true { let x = 2; } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = 1; x = 2; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { x = 2; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 0; on start { x = "bad"; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = missing; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } entity E { state r: R = R(y = 1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; y: Int; } entity E { state r: R = R(x = 1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } entity E { state r: R = R(x = 1, x = 2); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum K { A; } entity E { state k: K = K::B; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = None; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = Ok(1); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = Some(1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; fn f() -> Rat = time.delta(); entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; capability fx() -> Int effect; entity E { on start { let x = fx(); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; capability read() -> Int observation; entity E { on start { call read(); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = vec2(1); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = missing(); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 0; on start { match x { None => { return; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Option<Int> = Some(1); on start { match x { Some(v) => { return; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Result<Int, Text> = Ok(1); on start { match x { Ok(v) => { return; } Ok(w) => { return; } Err(e) => { return; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum A { X; } enum B { X; } entity E { state a: A = A::X; on start { match a { B::X => { return; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state value: Int = 0; state x: Option<Int> = Some(1); on start { match x { Some(value) => { return; } None => { return; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; behavior B { on update { return; } } entity E { use B; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on update(dt: Rat) { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on a { emit ping(1); } on b { emit ping("x"); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int) -> Int = f(x); entity E { on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; fn f(x: Int) -> Int = g(x); fn g(x: Int) -> Int = f(x); entity E { on start { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; import fmod; import cmod; entity E { on start { let x = read(); } }
module fmod version "1.0.0"; export fn read() -> Int = 1;
module cmod version "1.0.0"; export capability read() -> Int observation;
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record A { x: Int; } record B { x: Int; } entity E { state a: A = A(x = 1); on start { a = B(x = 1); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum K { A; B; } entity E { state k: K = K::A; on start { let x = k < K::B; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { on start { let x = (1).field; } }
